items.prompt: A pandas ewm result disagrees with the displayed first-seeded EMA on complete data. Which comparison can settle whether the algorithms match?

options.text: Compare function names only; both say EMA.
options.why: A shared name does not fix initialization, adjusted normalization or missing-data rules.

options.text: Use adjust=True because it is the public recurrence.
options.why: The public recurrence corresponds to the recursive variant, not the default adjusted-weight variant.

options.text: Compare span/alpha, adjust=False, seed and output policy.
options.why: These choices determine whether the library is implementing the same recursive path before any numerical tolerance check.

options.text: Sort the prices first to make both outputs stable.
options.why: Sorting changes the ordered input and therefore the EMA, rather than explaining the original mismatch.

items.explanation: These choices determine whether the library is implementing the same recursive path before any numerical tolerance check.
